title: Geometric sum: the closed form of the finite-calculus Sigma operator

located_defect.description: The source defines Sigma(T)(n) = sum_{k=1}^{n-1} T(k) and asserts the closed form Sigma(c^k)(n) = (c^n - 1)/(c - 1) (stored source line 0020). Read universally over the source's domain (c ≠ 1, n ≥ 1) over the reals this is the located defect. Supply the corrected closed form and prove the corrected identity on the whole domain; there is no separate target theorem for this record.
